pinned_inputs.role: complete pre-formula whole-map and source-readiness audit

delta_since_prior_whole_map_audit.meaning: The only new formula hypotheses admitted after the prior whole-map audit have now been consumed. Wide search found no robust replacement plateau, and both exact post-selection interactions reversed through their changed components in later intervals.

quality_tradeoff.interpretation: The fixed candidate has very high dollar density and profit uplift but lower turnover and mixed long-path recovery/smoothness. These already-closed statistics do not define a new causal treatment.

program_recomparison.program_1_entry_signal_market_structure: The 59-dimensional shared formula surface is complete, both surviving interactions are economically nontransferring, and all adjacent threshold, mode, window, component, symbol and direction rescues are frozen. No independent signal mechanism is ready.
program_recomparison.program_2_external_market_event: No new causally timed external state has arrived since the prior audit. Existing external-state families are closed, ambiguous or nonbridging; formula-period reversal alone cannot select a retrospective regime gate.
program_recomparison.program_3_order_time_session: Execution ownership, clocks, order/session and frequency-split neighborhoods are closed. The user ended the US30/US100 versus US500 split, and the Cross component still causally reads US500, so no independent lane treatment exists.
program_recomparison.program_4_position_management_exit: Stops, ARC, holds, giveback, peer exit, drawdown governors and open-exposure release mechanisms are closed. Formula nontransfer supplies no new held-position intervention.
program_recomparison.program_5_portfolio_capital_risk: Weights, risks, ladder, caps, occupancy, component state, allocation, same-symbol overlap and reserve mechanisms are closed. Re-expressing candidate risk-quality statistics is not a new action.
program_recomparison.program_7_diagnostic_causal_meta: Direct-versus-spillover attribution has resolved the final formula ambiguity. Another subgroup, attribution threshold, resample or report statistic cannot create an independent economic counterfactual.

natural_rlo1_readiness_metadata_only.conclusion: Metadata is unchanged from the pre-formula audit and no new complete natural lifecycle exists. Live was not restarted or polled, and broker/account state was not queried.

verdict.meaning: All currently ready formula information has been economically consumed. The absence of a genuinely independent next mechanism is a readiness boundary, not evidence against the fixed candidate and not Goal completion.

next_readiness_conditions: materially new naturally written complete RLO1 lifecycle evidence beyond the already consumed three-close snapshot
a new continuity- or lineage-pinned economic mechanism whose exact role has not already been incorporated, tested or frozen
an independent source with exact causal timing, a fixed actionable contrast, sufficient sample support and complete economic terminal decisions
forbidden_automatic_successors: formula neighbor, single-axis leg, threshold, polarity, window, component, symbol, direction, epoch or month rescue
weight, risk, ladder, occupancy, allocation, admission, stop, exit or drawdown-governor retune
another candidate-quality ratio, normalization, bootstrap, subgroup or significance statistic without a distinct action
Live restart, broker/account polling, synthetic Live rows or Master terminal use
